title: Bar Hamadura
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He was Shmuel’s student: in Yoma 87a, Bar Hamadura says, “I was standing before Shmuel.” In Shabbat 125a and Menachot 38b, Bar Hamadura speaks in Shmuel’s name; Shabbat 107b has Mar bar Hameduri speaking in Shmuel’s name (Hyman reports that Dikdukei Soferim omits Mar). Hyman infers that he lived a long life, for Rava says, “Bar Hameduri explained it to me,” in Shabbat 107b and 125a and Yevamot 83b. Rav Avdimi bar Hameduri is also found in Sukkah 20a.

notes.text: In the checked Shabbat passage, Rava says that Bar Hameduri explained the matter to him. “Rava Bar Hameduri” in the earlier English incorrectly fused the speaker and the cited teacher.

The long-life conclusion is Hyman’s inference. The consulted Shabbat 107b distinguishes Rava, who speaks, from Bar Hameduri, who explained the matter to him. The exact Dikdukei Soferim omission was not independently inspected.
